text: {"name":"rf_find_or_reserve_state_entry","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Searches the RF state table for an entry matching three 16-bit key fields, optionally marking and returning the first free slot.","subsystem":"rf","var_renames":{"a1":"key_fields","a2":"reserve_if_missing","v2":"entry","v3":"entries_end"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":0,"meaning":"occupied-state byte; zero denotes a free entry"},{"offset":2,"meaning":"first 16-bit key field"},{"offset":4,"meaning":"second 16-bit key field"},{"offset":6,"meaning":"third 16-bit key field"},{"offset":56,"meaning":"reservation/status byte set to 0x80 when a free entry is returned"}]}
